A little about me

Hi, I'm Nouh.

I'm a video editor based in Tlemcen, Algeria, with one year of editing experience. I use Adobe Premiere Pro and Adobe After Effects to work on social media videos, Reels, podcasts, and advertising content.

I've had experience working with clients and I'm building my freelance practice around helping people communicate their ideas through video.
